chunks: His power is only over those who take him as their patron, and those who ascribe equals (to God).
ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have power over according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nahl clarifies that Satan's 'authority' (sultan) is not coercive but persuasive, relying on the voluntary allegiance (tawall) of those who choose him. This distinction underscores the concept of free will, where Satan influences only those who actively align themselves with him through shirk, rather than dominating all humanity absolutely.
